local data={
	["Pink Bolete"]={name="Pink Bolete", tier=4, use="A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["Red Bolete"]={name="Red Bolete", tier=4, use="A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["Ruby Bolete"]={name="Ruby Bolete", tier=4, use="A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. Promotes Lv.60 operators.", desc="Every year, many frontier settlers would suffer multiple organ failure caused by ruby bolete poisoning. This often results from misjudging the edible stage of the fungus. Eating the fungus in ruby stage is extremely dangerous.", obtain="Area found: Power Plateau, Rare Gathering Sites, Dijiang Production: Growth Chamber, Jingyu Valley"},
	["Bloodcap"]={name="Bloodcap", tier=5, use="A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["Cosmagaric"]={name="Cosmagaric", tier=5, use="A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. Promotes Lv.80 operators.", desc="A common fungus that proliferated in various regions of Talos-II after the Cosmic Gate broke down. Terran fowlbeasts brought to the new world exhibit a special preference for these surprisingly hard \"local mushrooms\". Cosmagaric also disperse their spores by attaching them to the long feathers of the fowls.", obtain="PLACEHOLDER, Rare Gathering Sites, Dijiang Production: Growth Chamber, Wuling City"},
	["Kalkodendra"]={name="Kalkodendra", tier=4, use="A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["Chrysodendra"]={name="Chrysodendra", tier=4, use="A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. Farming dendras can be quite a challenge.", obtain="Area found: Originium Science Park, Rare Gathering Sites, Dijiang Production: Growth Chamber, Origin Lodespring"},
	["Vitrodendra"]={name="Vitrodendra", tier=4, use="A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["Blighted Jadeleaf"]={name="Blighted Jadeleaf", tier=5, use="A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["False Aggela"]={name="False Aggela", tier=5, use="A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["Kalkonyx"]={name="Kalkonyx", tier=4, use="A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["Auronyx"]={name="Auronyx", tier=4, use="A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["Umbronyx"]={name="Umbronyx", tier=4, use="A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["Igneosite"]={name="Igneosite", tier=5, use="A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["Wulingstone"]={name="Wulingstone", tier=5, use="A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. Tunes Lv.80 weapons.", desc="A mineral formation created by extremely complex hydrological changes. Wulingstone was first discovered by Hongshan Tianshi conducting hydrological surveys at the Wuling region. Under the influence of Æther, sediments carried by water would settle at certain depths and eventually form Wulingstone. These rocks are useful in fluviochronology and the study of local hydrological history.", obtain="PLACEHOLDER, Rare Mining Sites, Dijiang Production: Growth Chamber, Wuling City"},
